agents.name: Bob
memories: Water is the constraint that ends farms.
Do not plant more than we can water.

today.why: Water is the constraint that ends farms. Yesterday's pour took eight from the cistern under clear sky — fill it back to the brim before the growing row asks again.
today.expect: Cistern topped so tomorrow's field work never races the gauge.

yesterday.why: Water is the constraint that ends farms. The ripe ear is in the bin and a new row just went down under clear sky — push moisture onto the sprout before the ditch only slows the sip.
yesterday.expect: East field near the brim so the sprout holds through another clear day.

agents.name: Alice
memories: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve.
Ditches compound. Heat does not wait.

today.why: Ditches compound. Heat does not wait — read the east row after the pour and the sprout-to-growing advance, not after a wasted seed. Unused seeds stay a delay only if we plant into a full field.
today.expect: A moisture and crop reading before the next experimental move.

yesterday.why: Unused seeds are a delay only when the field is empty — the next row is already in. Ditches compound. Heat does not wait; timber while the sprout advances is the other compounding play.
yesterday.expect: Wood pile thicker before the sprout asks for hands again.
